answer: In some reports, a “virtual assistant” refers to AI software assistants such as chatbots, voice assistants, and digital agents. In other contexts, it refers to human remote professionals who provide business support online. The future of the industry includes both, and increasingly, they will work together.

citations.sourceTitle: The Future of the VA Industry
citations.heading: Introduction

patterns: what routine tasks can ai help with
what tasks can ai tools help a virtual assistant with
how can ai support virtual assistants
answer: AI systems can assist Virtual Assistants with many routine or time-consuming tasks, including drafting emails, notes, and first-pass documents, summarizing meetings or reports, researching information quickly, organizing tasks, reminders, and workflows, supporting scheduling and transcription, and handling simple customer queries through chatbots.

citations.sourceTitle: The Future of the VA Industry
citations.heading: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of VA Work

patterns: what human skills will clients value
what differentiators and qualities will clients value most
where do human virtual assistants add value
answer: Clients will increasingly value human differentiators and qualities such as responsiveness, dependability, emotional intelligence, professionalism, and clear communication.
